connection_lost.title: Davis Vantage station unreachable
connection_lost.description:
{name} has failed to respond for several polling cycles in a row. This usually means the console is powered off, the serial cable is disconnected, or - if this is a USB connection - the device was reassigned to a different port after a reboot.

Check the physical connection, then use **Settings > Devices & services > {name} > Reconfigure** to verify or update the port/link.

user.title: Connection method
user.description: Select how Home Assistant connects to your Davis Vantage console or WeatherLink logger.

reconfigure.title: Connection method
reconfigure.description: Select the connection method to verify for this Davis entry.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Select a Serial/USB interface or enter a WeatherLink host and port. Displaying this form does not open the interface.

verify.title: Verify Davis console/logger
verify.description: Verified {endpoint}. Detected baud: **{baud}**. LOOP2 is **{loop2}**. Continue to Davis options.

options.title: Davis options
options.description: Configure polling and connection lifecycle behavior.

data_description.use_loop2: Requests expanded LOOP2 data packets (LPS 2 1). Requires Vantage Pro2 or Vantage Vue console firmware v1.90 or newer. Leave disabled if you have older firmware or experience communication timeouts.
data_description.interval: Time between console read cycles. Default is 30 seconds. Serial connections should not be polled faster than every 10–15 seconds to prevent bus contention.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the weather station. Please verify the port or network address.
error.invalid_auth: Looks like the weather station isn't reacting, try again
error.no_davis_device: No Davis console responded. Check serial cable seating and verify the console is powered.
error.unsupported_loop2: The console rejected the LOOP2 command (LPS 2 1). Verify your firmware is version 1.90+ or disable LOOP2.
error.timeout: Console took too long to wake up or send an ACK byte.

abort.already_configured: This Davis Vantage device is already configured.
abort.identity_unavailable: The existing entry has a strong hardware identity, but the submitted interface did not expose one.
abort.wrong_device: The submitted interface identifies a different Davis logger or console.

init.title: Davis Vantage Options
init.description: Update station polling interval and protocol settings.

data_description.use_loop2: Requires firmware v1.90+. Leave disabled if your console does not support LOOP2.
data_description.persistent_connection: Keep serial transports open between polls. WeatherLink TCP is still released after each transaction so cloud uploads are not starved.

set_console_lamps.name: Set Console Lamps
set_console_lamps.description: Turns the physical LCD backlight on the Davis console on or off.

state.name: State
state.description: True to illuminate the backlight, False to turn it off.

clear_alarms.name: Clear Active Alarms
clear_alarms.description: Silences sounding alarms and resets active hardware alarm bits on the console.

set_barometer_calibration.name: Set Barometer Calibration
set_barometer_calibration.description: Sets the station elevation and, optionally, a known-good local barometer reading to fine-tune the console's adjusted-pressure calculation.

elevation.name: Elevation
elevation.description: Station elevation in feet (-2000 to 15000). This is the primary correction.

barometer.name: Barometer reading
barometer.description: A current barometer reading from a reliable nearby reference (20.000-32.500 inHg). Leave at 0 to clear any existing offset - do not use this alone to correct for sea level.

get_eeprom.name: Read EEPROM
get_eeprom.description: Reads raw bytes from the console's EEPROM at a given address. See the Davis Serial Communication Reference Manual's EEPROM address table for what each address holds.

address.name: Address
address.description: EEPROM address in hex, e.g. "2B" for SETUP_BITS.

set_eeprom.name: Write EEPROM
set_eeprom.description: Advanced/expert use only. Writes raw bytes to an allowed console EEPROM range. Factory calibration fields and settings managed by BAR= or SETPER are blocked.

address.name: Address
address.description: EEPROM address in hex, e.g. "2B" for SETUP_BITS.

data.name: Data
data.description: Bytes to write, as a hex string (e.g. "13" for one byte, "0102" for two).

run_test.name: Run Connection Test
run_test.description: Sends the TEST command and confirms the console echoes it back. A basic connection sanity check.

get_station_type.name: Get Station Type
get_station_type.description: Reads the WRD station-type byte (16 = Vantage Pro/Pro2, 17 = Vantage Vue).

rxtest.name: Reset Receiver Test Screen
rxtest.description: Moves the console off its "Receiving From..." screen and clears the RXCHECK CRC-error count.

get_receivers.name: Get Receivers
get_receivers.description: Reads the RECEIVERS bitmap of transmitter station IDs the console can currently hear.

get_calibrated_values.name: Get Calibrated Values
get_calibrated_values.description: Reads the CALED block of current calibrated sensor values.

set_calibrated_values.name: Set Calibrated Values
set_calibrated_values.description: Advanced/expert use only. Pushes a 43-byte CALFIX block of uncalibrated raw sensor values, matching the CALED layout.

data.name: Data
data.description: 43 bytes as a hex string (86 hex characters).

set_yearly_et.name: Set Yearly ET
set_yearly_et.description: Sets yearly evapotranspiration on the console (PUTET).

et_hundredths.name: ET (100ths of an inch)
et_hundredths.description: Yearly ET in 100ths of an inch, e.g. 2483 for 24.83in.
